Fantech MAXFIT108 MK855 RGB Mechanical Keyboard - White Space Edition

Elevate your desktop aesthetic to cosmic heights while securing pro-grade performance with the Fantech MAXFIT108 MK855 RGB Mechanical Keyboard White Space Edition. Available at Turbo Computer, this premium full-size hardware component is masterfully engineered for tech enthusiasts, esports competitors, and custom PC builders across Egypt who demand ultimate customization freedom and stable daily hardware performance. Featuring a stunning clean white space-themed design layout, it stands as the definitive choice for a high-tier battle station modification.

The MAXFIT108 MK855 White Space Edition features an advanced 5-pin hot-swappable key switch layout environment, allowing you to easily pull out and replace switches to customize your tactile preference without any soldering requirements. Outfitted with full-key anti-ghosting rollover tracking capability, it registers every command flawlessly during intense layout execution. It boasts brilliant per-key RGB backlighting matched with dynamic side-panel glow illumination systems flowing beautifully against the premium white frame, all safely powered via a highly reliable detachable Type-C connection interface system.
